linked_external_dependency: Homebrew openssl@3 (verified 3.6.3); this experiment does not redistribute it
purpose: Experimental macOS C API libraries for a future Swift client; no network connection during build verification.

verification.result: Built arm64 libfreerdp3, libfreerdp-client3 and libwinpr3. Reported FreeRDP 3.32.2 and initialized/freed a context without connecting.
verification.dependency_check: Linked dependencies are the existing OpenSSL 3 libraries, Apple frameworks and system libraries.
verification.first_attempt: Auto-detected Opus requested a missing opus/opus.h. Retried with the optional audio codec explicitly OFF; no source patch or additional runtime dependency.
verification.licenses: The script preserves upstream LICENSE and optional NOTICE under the private install prefix. Packaging and redistribution have not been implemented.

limitations: No H.264/AVC codec backend; only the included software codecs are available.
No UI, server, device redirection, clipboard, audio, Kerberos, Azure AD or connection probe.
Version/context initialization does not establish RDP, dynamic-resolution or RemoteApp interoperability.
Not integrated into the ordinary app build or distribution.
